runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0dedc55a2ffe0aUZiCK8eigmFA] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
**First-seen block arrival times — mainnet, 20 June 2026 (UTC)**

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total blocks | 7,180 |
| Slot range | 14,590,799 – 14,597,998 |
| Earliest arrival | 2026-06-20 00:12:42 |
| Latest arrival | 2026-06-21 00:52:46 |
| Min arrival delay (from slot start) | 141 ms |
| Avg arrival delay | 1,710 ms |
| Max arrival delay | 5,249 ms |

The data comes from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node` in the `clickhouse-refined` datasource. Each block's first-seen time is the earliest observation across all sentry nodes, computed as `min(slot_start_date_time + seen_slot_start_diff)`.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_0dedc55a2ffe0aUZiCK8eigmFA] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
Chart created and uploaded:

**Chart URL:** http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/e8ce72765545/aca63c18-07cc-4892-be33-3dfe2c68a4f4/arrival_delay_histogram.png

**Distribution stats for 7,180 blocks on mainnet, 20 Jun 2026:**

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Min delay | 141 ms |
| Median delay | 1,453 ms |
| Mean delay | 1,710 ms |
| Max delay | 5,249 ms |

The histogram shows a right-skewed distribution — most blocks are first seen within ~1–2 seconds of slot start, with a long tail up to ~5.2 seconds.
